title: The all-jobs-passed rollup waits on every Windows shard
why: A red or hung Windows shard does not hold the required all-jobs-passed check, so a batch can merge past it.
source: coordinator 12:22 CST Nov 12, from the Plan agent of lane time-limits-end-hangs-only
note: checks.yml rollup `needs` lacks windows-guard-2, windows-guard-3 and windows-merge-2 to -5. Also: all-jobs-passed and ci-done run only on pull_request, so they get no sample on main. Fix: a check that the rollup needs every job in the file (red first on today's file), then add the missing shards. R55 express (owner 14:05 CST Nov 12, via retrospective, plan fbc11be: "CI fixes need to be right up there in the express lane with the merging fixes"; home decision no-merge-during-batch-ci).
